mitigating_circumstances: Deceased was under influence of liquor and created heat of passion in the accused
trial_court_outcome: Convicted under s.302 IPC, sentenced to life imprisonment and fine of Rs. 500/-
offence_finally_established: Culpable homicide not amounting to murder under s.304 (Part I) IPC
neutral_facts: The accused was prosecuted for the death of his son, who was found stabbed. The prosecution alleged that the accused stabbed his son after the son, who was under the influence of liquor, created a disturbance in the house. The police seized the accused's blood-stained clothes, a knife, and blood-stained bed sheets. A chemical analysis report confirmed that the blood on the accused's clothes matched the deceased's blood group. The accused denied the allegations, but the trial court convicted him under Section 302 of the IPC. The High Court confirmed the conviction. The Supreme Court, however, found that the deceased's behavior under the influence of liquor created a heat of passion in the accused, leading to the conclusion that the offense fell under Section 304 (Part I) IPC. The accused had already served eight years of a life sentence, which was deemed sufficient punishment.
